gloss: to transfer money (to a bank account)

definitions.explanation: To deposit or transfer money into a bank account. A common financial term used for salary payments, bill payments, and bank transfers.

examples.japanese: {家賃|やちん}を{振|ふ}り{込|こ}む。
{給料|きゅうりょう}は{毎月|まいつき}{銀行|ぎんこう}に{振|ふ}り{込|こ}まれる。
examples.english: The salary is transferred to the bank every month.

examples.japanese: ATMから{相手|あいて}の{口座|こうざ}に{振|ふ}り{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I transferred the money to the other person's account from the ATM.

examples.japanese: {電気代|でんきだい}は{口座|こうざ}から{自動的|じどうてき}に{振|ふ}り{込|こ}まれる。
examples.english: The electricity bill is automatically transferred from the account.

notes:
{振|ふ}り{込|こ}む is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) used for bank transfers.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pattern: [money]を [account]に {振|ふ}り{込|こ}む
- Passive: {振|ふ}り{込|こ}まれる (commonly used for salary deposits)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {口座|こうざ}に{振|ふ}り{込|こ}む (transfer into an account)
- {銀行|ぎんこう}に{振|ふ}り{込|こ}む (transfer to a bank)
- {自動|じどう}{振|ふ}り{込|こ}み (automatic transfer)

RELATED WORDS:
- {振|ふ}り{込|こ}み: noun form (bank transfer)
- {振|ふ}り{込|こ}め{詐欺|さぎ}: wire transfer fraud (a common type of scam in Japan)
- {送金|そうきん}: remittance (more general term)
- {引|ひ}き{落|お}とし: automatic debit/withdrawal
